title: One YAML. One verified agent.
subtitle: A live onboarding demonstration without Substrate

pages.title: One YAML. One verified agent.
pages.lead: Choose approved inputs. Let the operator configure the runtime and its connections. Prove the new agent before handing it to its user.
bullets: The user selects model, MCP capabilities, skills, knowledge and an approved scenario.
The operator and trusted platform owners create the per-agent runtime and Gateway security.
Automatic authentication checks and the GoldenScenario produce a result tied to this exact request.
pages.note: Office target, not a completed office result. Shared infrastructure, images and approved content are prerequisites.

pages.title: The operator owns the wiring.
pages.lead: One owner request starts a controlled process. The agent runs as a normal approved workload without Substrate.
bullets: Bind the actual ModelConfig, MCP tools and pinned skill/knowledge releases.
Configure HTTPRoute, destination ReferenceGrants and strict JWT/authorization policies.
Keep access fail-closed during reconciliation. Use independent bounded verification authority.
Publish the usable endpoint only after the current security and GoldenScenario gates pass.
pages.note: Architecture illustration. Real readiness comes from Kubernetes; actual calls come from observed telemetry.

pages.title: Deploy, watch, invoke, verify.
pages.lead: Use a newly named agent so the audience can distinguish new onboarding from previously prepared resources.
bullets: Apply the final owner YAML through the approved delivery process.
Watch actual bindings, route/policy attachment and runtime readiness appear.
Watch automatic JWT checks and GoldenScenario execution against the secured endpoint.
Invoke as an approved caller, then show an unauthorized caller denied without forbidden dispatch.
pages.note: No manual per-agent fixes or separately prepared scenario Job. Keep tokens, prompts and raw tool results private.

pages.title: See what is happening now.
pages.lead: Extend the existing read-only OTel view with onboarding and verification evidence. Do not build a replacement observability stack.
bullets: Onboarding panel: named Kubernetes objects, current UID/generation, bindings and observation freshness.
Execution panel: received model/Gateway/MCP spans, call names, status and duration; real skill/knowledge-use metadata.
Verification panel: trusted JWT results, backend witnesses and the current GoldenScenario verdict.
Unknown, blocked and stale stay visible. No timer-driven success or invented connections.
pages.note: A received viewer trace does not prove Tempo ingestion. Verify traces, logs and metrics stores separately.

pages.title: Lab results and office gates stay separate.
pages.lead: The Gateway 1.7 home-lab receipts support a bounded technical result. The complete office onboarding demo still needs implementation and rehearsal.
bullets: Lab: three in-scope Gateway containers upgraded to digest-pinned 1.7.0 images.
Home lab, 3 November 2026: 30 security checks passed across two existing POCs, including allowed MCP calls and revocation checks.
Lab: a real model request produced two received Gateway spans and one access log in the existing OTel viewer.
Office still to prove: new one-file onboarding, automatic GoldenScenario, live lifecycle view and Tempo/log/metrics-store evidence.
pages.note: Historical lab receipt included in the pack. It is not a full standalone-agent workflow, office deployment or Substrate result.

pages.title: Leave evidence the team can use.
pages.lead: At the end, present what was actually delivered and show how another engineer can repeat the same demonstration.
bullets: Final owner YAML, editable-field guide and generated resource/binding inventory.
Current GoldenScenario result with actual model, MCP, skill and knowledge evidence; PASS is required for completion.
Protected live-view location, observed IDs, redacted captures and exact apply/invoke/watch/reset commands.
Named operational owners, artifact prerequisites, rollback steps and explicit remaining limits.
pages.note: Use the completion statement only after its gates pass. Substrate and Entra remain deferred; a Job must be described as a Job.
